description: Deletes the webinar of this session from the connected WordPress site. Take it only when the host clearly wants it gone, for example "That test run has to disappear." It needs the session id, and the campaign when the session holds more than one. It cannot be undone: the campaign and everything attached to it are gone, so the host should say a clear yes first. It only deletes on the site of this sign-in; without an open connection it says how to connect and deletes nothing. Words hosts use: delete webinar, remove, test run, start over

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.
